text:
sam: quick FYI — saw a bunch of customer tickets where SDKs see a 200 with an error payload and treat it as success. looks like our fallback routing returns a 200+body when we fall back to cheap model.

lina: ugh. that was the intentional behavior for transparent fallback, but i agree it breaks client semantics. we probably need to surface a non-2xx status or a header.

jit: right now fallback path sets 'fallback_reason' in the body and a console badge. SDKs don't look for that.

ana: suggestion: map quota/retryable-capacity issues to 429, routing-fallback-to-lower-quality -> 200 but with `x-degraded: true` and telemetry event. For hard degradations (service unavailable) -> 503.

sam: i like separating quota vs degraded-quality. quota hits should be actionable for clients (retry-after). degraded-quality should be opt-in for product owners.

lina: console UX ask: show a top-level route status "degraded" with severity tier (info/yellow/red) and link to the tenant-level telemetry for last 24h. Also show number of requests served by fallback in the route details.

jit: telemetry needs a consistent enum. propose `status_category` values: OK, DEGRADED_QUALITY, QUOTA_THROTTLED, ROUTE_UNAVAILABLE. emit `status_category` on every response event and set `http_status` to the actual response code.

ana: code sample for header mapping i'd propose:
```
if (quota_exceeded) -> status 429, header: "Retry-After"
else if (route_unavailable) -> status 503
else if (served_by_lower_quality_variant) -> status 200, header: "X-Degraded: true" and body.meta.fallback_reason
```

sam: question: will marking degraded as 200 break analytics that rely on count of errors? some customers expect error rate = 5xx/4xx. we should add a metric `policy_fallback_rate` to surface it.

lina: agreed. add a console KPI "fallback rate" per route and per model. default alert threshold 1%.

jit: SDK change: ship v0.9 that treats 2xx+`X-Degraded: true` as non-fatal but increments a client-side counter and emits a telemetry ping. Also expose `should_retry` based on 429/503 logic.

ana: ops-bot: deploy finished to staging 12:34 UTC :white_check_mark:
deploy-bot: build 2026.3.4-staging -> successfully rolled to staging hosts

sam: next steps: 1) telemetry enums PR (jit), 2) header/status mapping RFC (lina), 3) console badge + KPI (ana), 4) SDK change (jit). can we get estimates?

jit: telemetry PR by EOD tomorrow. SDK PR early next week.

lina: RFC draft by Friday.

ana: console mocks by next Wednesday. i'll add to the product board.

sam: cool. i'll open an incident-like tracking thread and notify eng-oncall for rollout windows. thanks everyone :thumbsup:

lina: adding note: backwards compatibility — we should support a feature flag at tenant level so existing customers can opt into new status mapping gradually.

jit: +1 on feature flag. we'll default to old behavior for 30 days in prod, then flip for new signups.

sam: perfect.
